guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：安全多方計算系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Secure multiparty-computation systems
guides.concept: 以秘密分享、協議威脅模型與通訊成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect secret sharing, protocol threat models and communication with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「參與方角色」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「隨機性要求」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分享隱私依賴足夠隨機且不重複的隨機量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「秘密乘法」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：區域性分享相乘通常缺少跨分享交叉項。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「展開兩個分享和的乘積找出交叉項。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「定點數值」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：定點縮放與截斷影響範圍及誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成小數比較不同縮放因子的誤差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「退出與終止」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：某些協議允許中止但不保證每方獲得輸出。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用紙上狀態圖分析一方離開。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「部署分離」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：模擬三個程序不等於真實獨立信任域。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分開標示本地驗證與實際信任部署要求。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for party roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for randomness requirements. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Share privacy needs adequate, unreused randomness. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for secret multiplication. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Local share products generally miss cross-share terms. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Expand share-sum products and locate cross terms. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for fixed-point numbers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fixed-point scaling and truncation affect range and error. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare scaling-factor errors for synthetic decimals. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for dropout and abort. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Some protocols permit abort without guaranteeing everyone an output. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze one party leaving with a paper state diagram. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for deployment separation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Three simulated processes are not independent trust domains. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Distinguish local validation from actual trust-domain requirements. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「成本驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報告每秒運算元就足以比較所有 MPC。」為何不成立。
提交「部署分離」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「分開標示本地驗證與實際信任部署要求。」如何辨別它們。
提交「部署分離」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同機三個程式證明了跨機構不串通。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for cost validation; explain why this claim fails: Operations per second suffice to compare all MPC systems.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for deployment separation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for deployment separation; explain why this claim fails: Three same-host processes prove institutional noncollusion.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：同機三個程式證明了跨機構不串通。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Three same-host processes prove institutional noncollusion. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
